title: Atena Polka Courgette - 2x Mini Plug Plants - Heavy Cropper Yellow
description:
Grow Your Own Delicious Golden Yellow Courgettes - High Yield & Sweet Flavour!


KEY FEATURES
• Prolific and high-yielding golden yellow courgettes
• Sweet flavour with a tender, thin skin
• Semi-compact bush habit, suitable for containers
• Easy to grow and low maintenance, ideal for beginners
• Harvest from early July until October frosts with regular picking


PLANT DETAILS
Type: Vegetables — Cucurbita pepo
Colour: Bright yellow
Season: Summer to early autumn (July - October)
Growth Habit: Bush
Flavour: Sweet, mild, and creamy with a tender texture
Time to Harvest: Approximately 50-60 days from planting, typically from early July


GROWING CONDITIONS
Sun: Full sun
Soil: Well-drained, humus-rich soil
Watering: Keep consistently moist, especially during fruiting. Water at the base of the plant.
Spacing: 90cm apart
Height: Up to 60-90cm
Spread: Up to 90-120cm
Hardiness: UK H1b


CARE INSTRUCTIONS
• Plant out after the last frost (late May/early June in the UK) in a sheltered, sunny spot.
• Ensure soil is rich in organic matter; feed every 14 days with a potash-rich fertiliser once fruits appear.
• Water regularly and deeply, especially in dry spells, but avoid wetting the fruit to prevent rot.
• Harvest fruits when 15-20cm long to encourage continuous production and maintain tenderness.
• Protect young plants from strong winds which can damage large leaves.


WHAT'S INCLUDED
2x Mini Plug Plants
